title: Learning From a Mistake
grammar: Past Conditional (ha + múlt idő + volna) and Unfulfilled Past Obligation (kellett volna)
goal: I can say what a mistake taught us.
I can say what we should have done differently.
I can explain what self-criticism and learning from mistakes mean.
